entries.65:19: God himself will rejoice over Jerusalem and his people, and weeping and crying will no longer be heard there. It means God takes joy in his people and will end their grief for good.
entries.65:20: In that renewed world, no baby will die young and no old person will die before a full life; dying at a hundred will seem young. It means God's future removes the tragedy of early death.
entries.65:21: People will build houses and actually live in them, plant vineyards and eat their fruit. It means God's future gives people secure, enjoyable results from their work.
entries.65:22: No one will build or plant only for someone else to take it; God's people will live long like trees and enjoy the work of their hands. It means God's future ends the injustice of losing what you worked for.
entries.65:23: Their work won't be wasted and their children won't be born for disaster, because they are a people God has blessed. It means God's blessing makes labor and family life fruitful and secure.
entries.65:24: God says he will answer before they even call and listen while they are still praying. It means God is eager and quick to respond to his people.
entries.65:25: Wolf and lamb will eat together, the lion will eat straw like an ox, and nothing will hurt or destroy on God's holy mountain. It means God's future brings complete peace, even among natural enemies.
entries.66:1: God says that heaven is his throne and earth is just a footstool, so no building people make could ever contain him. It means we shouldn't think we can box God into a place or a building we build for him.
entries.66:2: God made everything, yet the person he pays attention to is the humble one who is sorry for their sin and takes his word seriously. It means God values a humble, teachable heart more than anything we could build or offer him.
entries.66:3: People were going through the motions of worship while living in ways God hated, so their offerings became as bad as murder or unclean sacrifices. It means God is not impressed by religious activity when our hearts and lives are not really turned toward him.
entries.66:4: Because the people ignored God's voice and chose what he hated, he will let the very things they feared come upon them. It means ignoring God's warnings has real consequences, and refusing to listen leaves us exposed to what we dread.
entries.66:5: God tells those who tremble at his word that their own people who hate and reject them will be the ones put to shame. It means if you are mistreated for following God, he sees it and will vindicate you in the end.
entries.66:6: A loud noise of upheaval comes from the city and the temple, the sound of the Lord punishing those who hate him. It means God is not passive about evil; judgment will come, and it will be heard.
entries.66:7: Zion gives birth suddenly, before the pains of labor even come. It means God can bring about his purposes quickly and unexpectedly, beyond what anyone expects.
entries.66:8: No one has ever heard of a land or nation being born in a single day, yet Zion gives birth to her children all at once. It means God's restoration can happen suddenly, not slowly or by human effort.
entries.66:9: God asks whether he, who started the birth, would stop it halfway or hold the children back. It means God finishes what he starts, and he will not abandon the work he began in his people.
entries.66:10: Everyone who loves Jerusalem and grieves over her is called to rejoice with her. It means it is right to celebrate when God restores his people, and those who mourned with her get to share her joy.
entries.66:11: Jerusalem will comfort and nourish her children like a mother, and they will be satisfied with her glory. It means God's people will be fully cared for and filled with blessing from him.
entries.66:12: God promises to make peace flow to Jerusalem like a river, with the wealth of nations streaming in, and he will carry her children gently. It means God's peace and provision come abundantly, and he cares for his people tenderly.
entries.66:13: Just as a mother comforts her child, God will comfort his people, and that comfort will be found in Jerusalem. It means God's comfort is personal and tender, like a mother's, not cold or distant.
entries.66:14: When you see God's work, your heart will rejoice and your strength will be renewed like fresh grass, while God's anger falls on his enemies. It means seeing God act brings deep joy and new life to those who trust him.
entries.66:15: The Lord comes with fire and with chariots like a whirlwind to punish his enemies in his burning anger. It means God's judgment is real and powerful, not something to be taken lightly.
entries.66:16: The Lord will judge all the earth with fire and sword, and many will fall. It means God will hold the whole world accountable, and no one will escape his judgment.
entries.66:17: People who set themselves apart for pagan rituals, eating forbidden foods like pork and mice, will all come to an end together. It means religious show mixed with disobedience does not fool God; he sees both actions and thoughts.
entries.66:18: God will gather all nations and languages together, and they will come and see his glory. It means God's plan is bigger than one people; he intends to reveal himself to the whole world.
entries.66:19: God will send survivors to distant nations and islands that have never heard of him, and they will tell those peoples about his glory. It means God reaches out to those who don't know him yet, and he uses people to spread that news.
entries.66:20: People from all nations will bring the scattered Israelites back to Jerusalem as an offering to the Lord, using every kind of transport. It means God will bring his people home from everywhere, and the whole world will be part of it.
entries.66:21: God says he will take some of these returning people to serve as priests and Levites. It means God himself chooses and appoints those who serve him, and he opens that service to people from beyond the old lines.
entries.66:22: Just as the new heavens and new earth God makes will last forever, so the descendants and name of his people will last forever. It means God's people have a permanent, secure future that will never fade.
entries.66:23: From one new moon and Sabbath to the next, all people will come to worship before the Lord. It means worship of God will be continuous and worldwide, not limited to one nation or one day.
entries.66:24: People will look at the corpses of those who rebelled against God, where the worm never dies and the fire never goes out, and they will be horrified. It means rejecting God ends in permanent ruin, and that should make us take him seriously.
